docstring:
Adds an Excel section to the incoming experiment record.
Replicates PLP 'Add Excel Section' component behavior.

Per Pipeline Pilot specification:
- Creates a local Section record of type 'Excel Worksheet'
- Attaches the specified Excel file and configures table preview settings
- Validates that columns_to_preview < 8
- Appends the section to the experiment record's simplesections list
- Serializes the node structure matching @serial := nodeserialize(dataroot())

:param section_title: The title of the new section (required).
:param excel_file: Path or filename of the Excel spreadsheet (required).
:param preview_mode: 'Generate from Excel File Content' or 'Use Custom Image'.
:param columns_to_preview: Number of preview columns (must be < 8).
:param rows_to_preview: Number of preview rows.
:param column_preview_width: Width of column preview in pixels.
:param row_preview_height: Height of row preview in pixels.
:param preview_custom_image: Optional image path when preview_mode is 'Use Custom Image'.
:param experiment_record: Optional dictionary representing incoming experiment record.
:param experiment_id: Optional experiment identifier.
:param client: Optional BioviaNotebookClient for direct ELN persistence.
:return: Updated experiment record dictionary with the newly added section.
usage_example:
from biovia_pipeline.components.add_excel_section import add_excel_section

result = add_excel_section(

    section_title=..., excel_file=..., preview_mode=..., columns_to_preview=..., rows_to_preview=..., column_preview_width=..., row_preview_height=..., preview_custom_image=..., experiment_record=..., experiment_id=..., client=..., author=..., connection_name=...

)

docstring:

Per Pipeline Pilot specification:
- Creates a local Section record of type 'File Attachment'
- Attaches the selected files (supporting single file or list of files)

- Serializes the node structure matching @serial := nodeserialize(dataroot())

:param action: 'Replace' or 'Append' (default 'Replace').
:param experiment_record: Optional dictionary representing incoming experiment record.
:param experiment_id: Optional experiment identifier.
:param client: Optional BioviaNotebookClient for direct ELN persistence.
:return: Updated experiment record dictionary with the newly added section.

    section_title=..., files_to_attach=..., action=..., experiment_record=..., experiment_id=..., client=..., author=..., connection_name=...

)

docstring:
Adds a PowerPoint Presentation section to the incoming experiment record.
Replicates PLP 'Add PowerPoint Presentation Section' subprotocol behavior.

Per Pipeline Pilot specification:
- Creates a local Section record of type 'PowerPoint Presentation'
- Creates a message preview instructing user that preview will be generated when file is edited in Notebook
- Formats default preview width (600) and height (30)
- Serializes node structure and appends to the experiment record

:param section_title: The title of the new section (required).
:param powerpoint_file: Path or filename of the PowerPoint presentation (required).
:param preview_text: Message rendered on canvas/chart (default: "Preview will be generated when the file is edited.").
:param preview_width: Preview image width in pixels (default: 600).
:param preview_height: Preview image height in pixels (default: 30).
:param experiment_record: Optional dictionary representing incoming experiment record.
:param experiment_id: Optional experiment identifier.
:param client: Optional BioviaNotebookClient for direct ELN persistence.
:param author: Optional section author.
:param connection_name: Notebook connection identifier (default: "Connection1").
:return: Updated experiment record dictionary with the newly added section.
usage_example:
from biovia_pipeline.components.add_powerpoint_section import add_powerpoint_section

result = add_powerpoint_section(

    section_title=..., powerpoint_file=..., preview_text=..., preview_width=..., preview_height=..., experiment_record=..., experiment_id=..., client=..., author=..., connection_name=...

)

docstring:
Unified implementation of the Biovia Pipeline Pilot 'Custom Filter' component.

In Pipeline Pilot, 'Custom Filter' is a single component configured with an
'Expression' argument written in PilotScript (PLP script). This single function
accepts that PLP script expression and evaluates whether an incoming data record
passes the filter (True) or is filtered out (False).

Parameters:
    expression (str): The PLP script / PilotScript expression string.
        Examples:
          - "findsubstring(DocRelativepath, '.pdf')>1"
          - "findsubstring(DocRelativepath, '.xlsx')>1"
          - "@experiment_number is defined and @experiment_number is ne '' and @filelocation is eq ''"
          - "@xml is defined and @xml ne '' and @filelist is eq ''"
          - "@filelist is defined and @filelist is ne ''"
    record (dict, optional): Current data record attributes (e.g. {'DocRelativepath': 'test.pdf'})
    globals_dict (dict, optional): Global workflow variables (e.g. {'experiment_number': 'EXP-2026-01'})

Returns:
    bool: True if the record/condition passes the filter, False otherwise.
usage_example:
from biovia_pipeline.components.custom_filter import custom_filter

result = custom_filter(

    expression=..., record=..., globals_dict=...

)

docstring:
Unified implementation of the Biovia Pipeline Pilot 'Custom Manipulator (PilotScript)' component.

In Pipeline Pilot, the Custom Manipulator evaluates PilotScript statements for each incoming record.
It can query or alter properties on data records (%), access/mutate globals (@), and use local variables (#).

Parameters:
    expression (str): Main PilotScript expression or script block.
    record (dict, optional): Incoming record attributes to manipulate.
    globals_dict (dict, optional): Global workflow state.
    locals_dict (dict, optional): Component-scoped local variables.
    initial_expression (str, optional): PilotScript executed once upon initialization.
    final_expression (str, optional): PilotScript executed upon completion.
    keep_calculated_properties (bool): If True, retains newly assigned record properties.

Returns:
    Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, Any]]:
        (updated_record, updated_globals, updated_locals)
usage_example:
from biovia_pipeline.components.custom_manipulator import custom_manipulator

result = custom_manipulator(

    expression=..., record=..., globals_dict=..., locals_dict=..., initial_expression=..., final_expression=..., keep_calculated_properties=...

)

docstring:
Extracts, filters, deduplicates, and sorts sections from an incoming experiment record or ELN server.
Replicates PLP 'Extract Sections from Experiment' component behavior.

:param experiment_record: Incoming Experiment or Template record dictionary (required if experiment_id is not given).
:param experiment_id: Direct experiment number or ID override.
:param what_to_extract: "All Section Types" or "Selected Section Types".
:param section_types: List of section type names when what_to_extract is "Selected Section Types".
:param connection: Optional NotebookConnectionObject holding credentials / endpoint.
:param client: Optional BioviaNotebookClient for live/mock ELN queries.
:param sort_by_index: If True, sorts sections by indexindocument ascending (PLP Sort Data LocalID 56).
:param deduplicate_by_id: If True, keeps only first occurrence of each section id (PLP First Occurrence Filter LocalID 35).
:return: List of extracted section records with enriched metadata and parent experiment linkage.
usage_example:
from biovia_pipeline.components.extract_sections import extract_sections

result = extract_sections(

    experiment_record=..., experiment_id=..., what_to_extract=..., section_types=..., connection=..., client=..., sort_by_index=..., deduplicate_by_id=...

)
